niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” CTV advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs and whether you want a full-service holding‑company shop, a programmatic specialist, or a boutique that focuses only on CTV.

How to pick the best agency for you
- Primary objective: brand awareness vs performance/ROI vs direct response vs audience building.
- Budget and campaign scale: global vs national vs local; creative production budget.
- Buying approach: direct buys with platform partners (Roku, Samsung, Xandr/MSFT Ads) vs programmatic DSP-driven buying.
- Measurement & attribution needs: third‑party verification (Nielsen, iSpot, TVSquared, DoubleVerify, IAS).
- Creative capabilities: need dynamic/adaptive or interactive CTV creatives?
- Industry/regulatory constraints: e.g., healthcare, finance, kids.

Agencies and partners to consider (by use case)
- Full-service / Big-brand campaigns (global reach + integrated media/creative/strategy):
  - GroupM (Mindshare, Wavemaker, Essence)
  - Omnicom Media Group (OMD, PHD)
  - Publicis Media (Starcom, Zenith)
  - Dentsu (Carat, Vizeum)
  - IPG Mediabrands (Initiative, UM)
- Programmatic / performance-oriented:
  - The Trade Desk (platform/DSP partners; many agencies build on TTD)
  - Amobee
  - Tremor Video / Tremor DSP
  - Cadent (TV programmatic solutions)
- Platform-native / streaming partners (great if you want direct access & first-party data):
  - Roku Advertising (OneView)
  - Samsung Ads
  - Xandr / Microsoft Advertising
  - Amazon OTT / Prime Video Ads
- Creative / interactive CTV specialists:
  - Innovid (creative/ad serving/measurement for CTV)
  - Eko (interactive stories/experiences)
  - Boutique creative shops with CTV teams (R/GA, 72andSunny, plus many digital-first boutiques)
- Measurement / verification partners (often used alongside any agency):
  - Nielsen, iSpot.tv, TVSquared, DoubleVerify, Integral Ad Science

A quick recommendation approach
- If you’re a large brand running national/global brand campaigns: start with 2–3 holding‑company agencies that already handle video/TV and ask for their CTV case studies.
- If you need performance and granular targeting: shortlist programmatic specialists or a Trade Desk-certified partner.
- If you need innovative creative or interactive formats: pick a creative/CXM specialist that integrates with measurement providers.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–4 specific agencies matched to your business (tell me: industry, budget, target market, goals, need for creative/measurement).
- Draft an RFP checklist or sample questions to evaluate CTV agencies.

Which of those would help most right now?
